clue.text: The whim of the composer?

definitions.meaning: the composer's sense is a musical note worth one beat

explanation.definitionFit: A crotchet is both an eccentric notion and a quarter note in written music, the kind a composer puts on the stave.

clue.text: Band in the theatre

definitions.meaning: the theatre sense is the upper tier of seats

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a ring-shaped band and also a curved balcony tier of seating in a playhouse.

clue.text: Fresh topics for light-minded scientists

definitions.note: the clue names the people; the answer is the subject such scientists, interested in light, study

indicators.note: fresh suggests a new version, so the letters of topics are made over

explanation.surface: A suggestion of new discussion topics for frivolous researchers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light-minded' looks like frivolous, but it means scientists whose minds are on light; the answer is their field of study.
explanation.definitionFit: Optics is the branch of physics concerned with the behaviour of light, the subject of light-focused researchers.

clue.text: Fifty or a hundred turn up to sing

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the assembled string from bottom to top, so it is reversed

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Fifty or a hundred people arrive to sing together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn up' sounds like people arriving; it reverses LORAC, built from L, OR, A and C.
explanation.definitionFit: To carol is to sing joyfully, especially a Christmas song.

clue.text: A gentle arrangement exhibiting good taste

indicators.note: an arrangement of letters is a reordering of the words a gentle

explanation.surface: A soft flower display that shows refined taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegant describes something graceful and stylish, showing refinement.

clue.text: He takes orders from I down

indicators.note: made from signals the answer is formed out of the letters of another entry, rearranged

parts.note: I down is entry 1 down, whose answer CIRCLE supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A man takes instructions from whoever is listed below him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I down' is the printed form of 1 down; its answer is rearranged. 'takes orders' is a priest's ordination, not obeying commands.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman is ordained, that is, he receives holy orders.

clue.text: Wild-cat strikes will put him out of work

definitions.text: Wild-cat strikes will put him out of work

parts.words: Wild-cat strikes will put him out of work
parts.note: read as an industrial dispute, but the wild cats are lions or tigers that maul the circus performer who controls them

explanation.definitionFit: A circus performer who trains big cats would lose his livelihood if one attacked him.

clue.text: Makes a new arrangement when a number break the rules

indicators.note: a and number break into rules, splitting the word apart from inside

parts.note: to reign is to rule
L is the Roman numeral fifty, a number

explanation.surface: Sets up anew when a group of people defy the regulations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' looks like the verb of rule-breaking, but it signals the a-and-number pair splitting the word for rules from inside; 'a number' is not a group of people.
explanation.definitionFit: To realign is to set things back in order or position them differently.

clue.text: Tell-tale weapon

parts.note: not a revealing weapon but the one in the tale of William Tell, the Swiss archer who shot an apple from his son's head

explanation.definitionFit: William Tell's legendary feat was done with a bolt-firing bow mounted on a stock.

clue.text: Held back free trade when in the red

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit within the word red
free suggests the letters of trade are loosed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Liberal commerce was restrained while the country was in debt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free trade' reads as a single economic term, but 'free' rearranges TRADE to TARDE, placed in RED.
explanation.definitionFit: Retarded means delayed or slowed in progress.

clue.text: A motto put out for the vegetarian

definitions.note: the definition describes the answer as something suitable for a meat-free eater

indicators.note: put out means disturbed, so the letters of a motto are disarranged

explanation.surface: A slogan is published for meat-free diners.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomato is a fruit eaten as a vegetable, a food suitable for those who avoid meat.

clue.text: Error the potter has to cover?

definitions.meaning: the potter's sense is liquid clay used to coat or decorate ware

explanation.definitionFit: A slip is a minor blunder, and also the creamy clay a ceramicist paints over a pot.

clue.text: Ring of the cheapest sort?

parts.note: ring suggests jewellery, but it is a telephone call, and the cheapest kind is to a nearby number

explanation.definitionFit: Phone calls within the same area were charged at the lowest rate.

clue.text: Works in which the unwary get caught

definitions.text: in which the unwary get caught
definitions.meaning: nets or snares, as in caught in the ...

explanation.definitionFit: To toil is to labour hard, and toils as a plural noun are traps or nets.

clue.text: Opening for a machine operator

parts.note: sounds like a job vacancy for an operative, but it is the coin aperture through which a player operates a gaming machine

explanation.definitionFit: A narrow aperture that takes coins is what starts a fruit machine working.

clue.text: Chopping up the garlic with apathy

indicators.note: chopping up suggests cutting into pieces, so the letters of the garlic are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cook listlessly dices garlic without enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethargic means sluggish and indifferent, lacking energy or interest.

clue.text: Variation in tempo may make things hot

definitions.note: the answer, a pepper, is something that may spice food

indicators.note: a variation alters the order of the letters in the words in tempo

explanation.surface: A change of musical pace can heat up a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tempo' looks like the musical fodder alone, but 'in' joins it: IN TEMPO has seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimento is a red pepper, used to spice dishes.

clue.text: Pop article in a French newspaper

indicators.note: the article sits within the name of the newspaper

parts.note: Le Monde is a leading Paris daily
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A piece about pop music in a Paris paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop' looks like music; it is a fizzy drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop is a fizzy soft drink, such as the lemon-flavoured one.

clue.text: Clear evidence of what a ship is carrying

definitions.text: evidence of what a ship is carrying
definitions.meaning: the cargo list a vessel carries for customs

explanation.definitionFit: Manifest means evident, and a manifest is a document listing a vessel's cargo.

clue.text: I am put in a ruined castle for a stretch maybe

indicators.note: put in means inserted, so the letter I goes into the rearranged castle
a ruined building is broken apart, so the letters of castle are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is imprisoned in a crumbling fortress for a term, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stretch' reads as a prison term; 'ruined' rearranges CASTLE to ELASTC, with I put in.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic material is used where something must give and spring back.

clue.text: Some leg of beef

parts.note: part of the lower leg, and also the young animal that grows into beef cattle

explanation.definitionFit: The back of the lower leg shares its name with a young bovine.

clue.text: It's a type of fuel, God willing, used without hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the two letters for God willing go round the hesitation

parts.note: DV abbreviates the Latin deo volente, God willing
er is a hesitant sound

explanation.surface: A fuel that, God willing, gets used without any delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like a deletion signal; here it has its old sense of outside. Derv is the British name for diesel fuel for road vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Derv is diesel oil used by road vehicles in Britain.

clue.text: Possibly glad I included it in a sort of watch

indicators.note: it is included, placed inside the rearranged letters
possibly suggests one possible order of the letters of glad I

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone is glad to have bought a timepiece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges GLAD I to DIGAL, and 'included' puts IT inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A digital watch shows time as numerals rather than with hands.

clue.text: Menace of the Mad Hatter

indicators.note: mad means crazy, so the letters of hatter are scrambled

explanation.surface: The danger posed by the Alice in Wonderland character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad Hatter' reads as the Lewis Carroll character, but 'Mad' rearranges HATTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A threat is a menacing warning of harm.

clue.text: A new paper to be published

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters of paper

explanation.surface: A newly launched paper is about to come out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new paper' looks like a fresh journal, but 'new' is the anagram signal working on paper, placed after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: A book or article is said to appear when it comes out in print.

clue.text: Board has the agreement of the French and German

parts.note: oui is French for yes
ja is German for yes, agreement understood from before

explanation.surface: The board of directors wins French and German approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board' suggests directors; it is the lettered seance board.
explanation.definitionFit: A ouija is a lettered board used in seances to receive messages.

clue.text: Fast vessel showing the way to others

definitions.text: Fast vessel showing the way to others

parts.words: Fast vessel showing the way to others
parts.note: fast suggests speed, but it means moored fixed in place, a ship that carries a beacon to guide other vessels

explanation.definitionFit: A moored ship carrying a beacon warns and guides passing craft like a floating lighthouse.

clue.text: Times by the score

parts.note: not twenty times over, but speeds marked in a musical score

explanation.definitionFit: Tempi are the plural of tempo, speeds at which music is played as marked in the written music.

clue.text: Exact payment for something on another's account

definitions.text: Exact payment for something on another's account

parts.words: Exact payment for something on another's account
parts.note: reads like collecting a debt for a client, but it is taking revenge on behalf of someone wronged

explanation.definitionFit: To take vengeance is to exact retribution for a wrong done to someone else.

clue.text: Stock reaction to panic

parts.note: stock suggests shares or a standard response, but it is livestock reacting to fright

explanation.definitionFit: A herd of cattle seized by fear bolts en masse.

clue.text: Tempt a number to break the ice

indicators.note: to break the number means its letters are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: ten is a number
taken as written

explanation.surface: Lure a group to make the first move socially.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break the ice' reads as starting a conversation; 'break' instead scrambles a number, with the ice following as written.
explanation.definitionFit: To entice is to lure or tempt someone.

clue.text: Strange relics to be found in the cathedral

indicators.note: strange means odd, so the letters of relics to are rearranged

explanation.surface: Odd holy relics turn up in a great church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relics to' supplies eight letters; 'Strange' reorders them.
explanation.definitionFit: A covered arcade round a quadrangle is part of many cathedral precincts.
